summary: HUD text renderer. In a single-lap session (total laps read from a3+16480 == 1) it looks up the localized LAPS string and formats "<lap> <LAPS>". Otherwise it computes the remaining session time as the difference between a session total and a per-this value, decomposes the positive remainder into minutes and fractional seconds, and formats either "%.3f" or "%d:%06.3f". It then formats a position-suffix character from byte_5D4AE8 plus lap index, and renders the suffix and the lap/time text at successive positions with UITextRenderWithScale, storing both texts back into session/buffer slots.

If v4 == 1 (single-lap session), take the lap-count text path; otherwise the elapsed-time path.

Select format based on v15: "%.3f" when v15 <= 0, else "%d:%06.3f" with v15 as minutes.

Format position-suffix character into SrcStr: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(SrcStr, "%c", v5 + byte_5D4AE8), indexing a suffix table by lap index v5.
